checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Realistic wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn
must.why: Log cabin, pines, mist, warm pink-orange dawn glow; very photoreal.

must.item: Camera advances smoothly toward front door throughout
must.why: Cabin grows from small to filling the frame with the door centered across frames.

must.item: Foreground trees shift relative to cabin showing forward movement
must.why: Trunks and pine branches slide past the edges and change position between frames, giving strong parallax.
Cabin, door, chimney stub and roof stay consistent across the four frames; it looks like one continuous shot.
Frames are 854x480 (16:9); the assistant said no sound. Audio cannot be checked from frames.

faults.what: The cabin is a small shed-like hut with a flat roof and a log stub on the roof; it looks slightly odd but not broken.
Foreground trunk covers part of the cabin in the last frame, and the door is off-center.

summary: A photoreal dawn pine-forest log cabin with a smooth push-in toward the door and clear foreground parallax; only minor quirks.
